sentences.en: How about giving me a promotion from just-a-friend to boyfriend?
sentences.zh: 把我俩的关系从普通朋友提升到男朋友怎么样？

sentences.en: I don't have much in common with my left-handed boyfriend.

sentences.en: He's not my boyfriend, it's just platonic love with benefits!
sentences.zh: 他不是我男朋友，我们只是柏拉图式的纯洁友情附带福利！

senses.zh: 男朋友(女子的)情人；情夫
